verdicts.title: On automorphism groups of the conjugacy class type Cayley graphs on the symmetric and alternating groups
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: Abstract The automorphism groups of Cayley graphs on symmetric groups, Cay(G, S), where S is a complete set of transpositions have been determined. In a similar spirit, automorphism groups of Cayley graphs Cay(An, S) on alternating groups An, where S is a set of all 3-cycles have also been determined. verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract determines automorphism groups of specific Cayley graphs on symmetric/alternating groups but says nothing about Boolean circuits, monotone circuit width, or any correlation between automorphism group counts and circuit complexity measures.
